task_scope: FactoryBench Level 4 industrial troubleshooting from machine telemetry
supported_formats: single_letter_mcq: exactly one allowed option letter
applicability_conditions: Use only when the item is a FactoryBench L4 telemetry troubleshooting prompt
For MCQ items, preserve the single-letter-only contract
For free-form items, answer the requested diagnosis and remediation directly

failure_taxonomy.description: Core-only output identified a static-hold contact-force-estimation drift, while the development reference expected a process-sequence/task-phase interpretation. This is a single-item content error and does not establish a recurring supported rule.
Core-only behavior satisfied the single-letter MCQ contract and matched the reference on the available MCQ development item, so no format or reasoning adapter is justified for this subgroup.

fallback_policy: Use Core-only behavior for all FactoryBench L4 items.
predicted_regression_risks: Adding a rule from the single free-form miss could overfit to one telemetry pattern and incorrectly override valid sensor-drift diagnoses.
Adding domain-specific task-phase or loosening heuristics from one example could weaken previously correct behavior on other anomaly types.
Any broad change to anomaly detection could regress the already-correct MCQ subgroup.
evidence_limitations: Only two development items are available.
Only one Core-only failure is present, so no repeated failure mechanism is established.
The available failed free-form item alone is insufficient to justify a task adapter without risking case-specific memorization or unsupported domain assumptions.
No previous adapter exists for comparison.
